name: Old Town of Ávila with its Extra-Muros Churches
description: Ávila sits on a high plateau in Castile and León, at over 1,130 metres the highest provincial capital in Spain. Its medieval granite walls, begun in the 11th century, are the most complete in the country, with 82 round towers and nine gates. You can walk along the ramparts, then visit the fortress-like Gothic cathedral and the town where St Teresa was born.
